evals.name: broad-review-routes-findings
evals.prompt: Review this checkout feature for code-quality improvements. It repeats status checks, duplicates a fee formula, mixes API calls with rendering, and contains an unexplained 86400.
evals.expected_output: Reviews all four lenses, ranks concrete findings, and applies the matching specialist guidance without editing.

assertions.text: Covers branching, duplication, responsibilities, and the hidden value
Ranks findings by impact or confidence
Does not edit because the request says review

evals.name: cohesive-code-left-alone
evals.prompt: Clean up this cohesive 180-line parser module. It has one clear state machine, no repeated rules, and named constants for every protocol boundary.
evals.expected_output: Does not manufacture structural work merely to shorten the file and reports that the module is cohesive.

assertions.text: Does not split the file based on line count alone
Explains why the existing cohesion is valuable

evals.name: review-only-mode
evals.prompt: Audit the changed files for structural code smells and give me recommendations only.
evals.expected_output: Inspects and reports findings without changing files.

assertions.text: Treats audit and recommendations only as read-only
Reports locations and smallest recommended changes

evals.name: refactor-sequences-work
evals.prompt: Refactor this tangled order handler. It repeats mode branches, copies tax logic, mixes persistence with formatting, and uses boolean arguments.
evals.expected_output: Preserves behavior, sequences relevant changes to avoid rework, checks each coherent unit, and stops when further abstraction would add navigation.

assertions.text: Uses a sensible order rather than changing every lens at once

evals.name: specific-concern-routes-directly
evals.prompt: Find duplicated business rules in these invoice services. Do not review anything else.
evals.expected_output: Uses consolidation guidance directly and does not expand into a broad quality audit.

assertions.text: Does not add branching, file-layout, or literal findings
Reports without editing because the request says find
